capabilities: Insert a live session bar into a note
Record start, end and duration with breaks excluded
Run pomodoro cycles with phase alerts
Store sessions as plain-text code blocks
Show active sessions in the status bar
disambiguation: Not a calendar time-blocking tool; it records elapsed work sessions as plain-text code blocks inside notes.
extras: Sessions live only in note code blocks; data.json holds settings and the open-session list. Mobile works but has no status bar or system notifications.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to time how long you spend on a note, and external trackers keep that data outside the vault.
summary: Plain-text session timer that inserts a live bar into notes, logging start and end times, duration, breaks and optional pomodoro cycles.
